community.help_title: How Does This Digital Tool Help Village Groups?
community.help_intro: To ensure farmers directly benefit from village-level farm ponds and check dams built by Paani Foundation or NAAM Foundation initiatives:
community.help_1: Individual Storage Tracking: Farmers can monitor remaining daily water reserves in shramdaan-excavated farm ponds on their phones.
community.help_2: Seasonal Water Budgeting: Farmers can forecast in advance whether their stored water is sufficient for upcoming Rabi or summer crops.
community.help_3: Maintenance Reminders: Automated timely alerts for pre-monsoon inlet desilting and filter cleaning.
community.disclaimer: Accuracy Rule & Disclaimer: The information presented here is compiled directly from the organizations' official websites (organization-reported). This website is an educational community project developed by the Department of Information Technology at Don Bosco Institute of Technology (DBIT), Mumbai, and does not represent an official partnership.

sdg.title: Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 6, 13, 15)
sdg.subtitle: Every feature in this platform is directly mapped to United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
sdg.sdg6_1: Storage Tracker & Daily Simulation: Enhancing water-use efficiency and cutting shortage days (Target 6.4).
sdg.sdg6_2: Water Quality Testing: Verifying drinking safety of stored water against BIS IS 10500 to curb waterborne illnesses (Target 6.1).
sdg.sdg6_3: Community Movement Support: Encouraging local Gram Panchayats and watershed committees in equitable water allocation (Target 6.b).
sdg.sdg13_1: Seasonal Rainfall Forecast (AI): Helping farmers prepare for climate extremes with timely sowing schedules and drought preparedness.
sdg.sdg13_2: Runoff Capture: Intercepting intense monsoon cloudburst runoff on farmland to replenish regional groundwater tables.
sdg.sdg15_1: Soil Fertility Assessment: Enhancing organic carbon, arresting topsoil erosion, and restoring saline soils (Target 15.3 - Land Degradation Neutrality).
sdg.sdg15_2: Organic Mulching & Agroecology: Preserving soil moisture to protect vital subterranean microbial biodiversity.
home.features_subtitle: Practical digital tools engineered specifically for farmers' water conservation needs
home.feat_calc_desc: Accurately calculate how many lakh litres of rainwater your farm or rooftop can harvest (1 mm rain × 1 sq.m = 1 Litre).
home.feat_tank_desc: Record daily inflow and outflow from farm ponds or tanks. Receive automatic scarcity alerts when storage drops below 20%.
home.feat_fert_desc: Input soil Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, and pH to get a 0–100 fertility score and tailored organic improvement advice.
home.feat_ai_desc: Machine learning seasonal rainfall forecasts and water balance planning based on 115 years of IMD meteorological data.
home.feat_cost_desc: Estimate annual savings from replacing private water tankers and calculate the exact payback period of your storage structure.
home.feat_gw_desc: Interactive GIS map with India WRIS observation wells displaying live groundwater table depths across Maharashtra talukas.
home.schemes_desc: Key financial subsidy schemes provided by the state government for farm ponds and water conservation. (Note: For current eligibility and application, contact your local Taluka Agriculture Officer or Gram Panchayat).
home.scheme_1: Magel Tyala Shettale (Farm Pond on Demand): Direct bank transfer subsidies for farm pond excavation and plastic geomembrane lining.
home.scheme_2: Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan 2.0: Village-level stream deepening, check dam repairs, and watershed conservation works.
home.scheme_3: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY): 55% to 80% government financial assistance for micro-irrigation (Drip & Sprinkler).
